purpose: Lane C-market baseline (directive 2026-10-25 §6C/§9). RESEARCH ONLY: no served value, rank, weight, curve, bridge or flag changed.

inputs.packageModelUntouched: geom_q078_v1 (not read or exercised by this script)

starterBenchByTier.note: Rosters are TODAY's; weeks 1-6 are replayed on them (a player acquired mid-season is credited with weeks he was elsewhere).  Realized production, not expected; 'unvalued' = no canonical price (UNKNOWN, never 0).

idpTradeCalcNative.rankBasis: player-only ranks (picks excluded) on both boards unless 'WithPicks'

draftSharksCombinedNative.rankBasis: player-only ranks (picks excluded) on both boards unless 'WithPicks'

bridgeTrace.levelAttributionMethod: per row: anchor block weight (1 - alphaShrinkage) when a subgroup vote exists, else 1; within a block, each contributing source's appliedWeight share.  A shared-market-translated (IDP-only) vote is attributed to the ladder seed.  An APPROXIMATION: the blend is a count-aware weighted mean-median, not a weighted mean, so shares describe influence, not exact derivatives.
bridgeTrace.hierarchicalBlendScope: IDP and pick rows (offense: flat count-aware blend)

baseline.description: the pinned build, unchanged (control: must equal the in-process build)

no_idpTradeCalc.description: idpTradeCalc removed everywhere (vote AND ladder seed); the next usable bridge (draftSharks) seeds the shared-market ladder

ladder_seed_draftSharks.description: same voters; the shared-market ladder is seeded by draftSharks instead of idpTradeCalc (registry order swapped, limit 1)

ladder_multi_bridge.description: same voters; ladder seeded by every usable bridge (RISKIT_FEATURE_MULTI_BRIDGE_LADDER=1 in the worker process only)

ladder_ranks_x0.80.description: shared-market ladder ranks x0.80 (translated IDP-only votes land 20% higher on the combined board)

idptc_idp_values_x0.80.description: idpTradeCalc DL/LB/DB values x0.80 in its CSV (its cross-position level 20% lower; offense and picks untouched)

ds_idp_values_x0.80.description: draftSharksIdp '3D Value +' x0.80 (its IDP level lower against its own offense half)

idpTradeCalc.superflex: ON (scraper sets the site's SF toggle; Dynasty Scraper.py ensure_toggles_on)
idpTradeCalc.tePremium: ON (scraper sets the site's TEP toggle)
idpTradeCalc.idpScoring: UNAVAILABLE: no IDP scoring basis is stated in the ingested payload (name, value, position, team); the calculator is a generic public board, not synced to this league
idpTradeCalc.teams/roster/IDP starters: UNAVAILABLE: not stated in the payload

draftSharks.leagueSync: the vendor page is driven with its league selector set to this league's synced copy (scripts/fetch_draftsharks.py LEAGUE_ID); the vendor applies scoring client-side
draftSharks.idpScoring: UNVERIFIED: whether the vendor reproduces this card's custom keys (tiered reception, TFL, PD) is not observable from the CSV

teMismatch.note: the IDPTC board is read with TE premium ON while this card's bonus_rec_te is the value above; the same TE++ basis is the canonical board's constant target basis (CLAUDE.md step 5a), so this is a board-wide assumption, not an IDPTC-only one

implied.caveat: a starting-slot share is not a value share (replacement depth differs by position); shown only to place the market's IDP share in context

cardAlignment2026wk.method: Spearman(market IDP value, 2026 wk1-N league-card ppg) minus Spearman(same, tackle-heavy reference card ppg), same players, paired bootstrap; DESCRIPTIVE (the boards already know these games: in-sample)

correlationReproduction.outcome: 2026 regular-season weeks 1-6 league-scored points per game (players with >= 3 games with gp > 0), live dynasty_main card
correlationReproduction.cohort: every priced player row (rankDerivedValue > 0) joined by Sleeper id, position from the Sleeper player directory; picks and K excluded

pinnedInSeason_20261025.sampleType: IN-SAMPLE / hindsight: the board was built after weeks 1-6

pointInTimePreseason_20260909.sampleType: OUT-OF-SAMPLE for 2026 data: archive scraped 2026-09-09 21:15 UTC, source tree at that day's refresh commit, both before kickoff.  Methodology is TODAY's code (not the code served that day)

investigationB_servedPreseason_20260825.sampleType: OUT-OF-SAMPLE: Investigation B's served 2026-08-25 board, values exactly as served that day

investigationB_inSeasonRebuild_20261020.sampleType: IN-SAMPLE: B's 2026-10-20 archive rebuilt with today's code and the main tree current at that archive (B's own b8008c2a4 tree is not reachable)

preseasonSameCohort.sampleType: OUT-OF-SAMPLE; the SAME players (priced on both pre-season boards), so a difference is board date + methodology, not cohort
